packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major updates across pub and github-actions
Major updates wait for manual approval on the dependency dashboard

lockFileMaintenance.description: Enabled globally; pub is the only lock file in this repo and is excluded below on purpose — see the pub block for why

pub.description: Renovate resolves lock files with its own toolchain, not the Flutter SDK pinned in tool/flutter-version, so a lock it writes cannot be installed under the pin; direct-dependency PRs still re-resolve transitives
